text:
incident-bot: 🚨 Paging SRE — private pool auth failures for tenant HelixBank detected in us-west-2. Error rate spike on dedicated pool helix-prod-auth: 5xx auth failures, user tokens rejected. PID: 0x7c. Root ts: 3467890123
Priya (SRE-oncall): I'm on it. Can someone drop the first error traces?
Ajay (eng-infra): logs from auth-proxy: `oidc: id_token expired` across ~12 pods. Seeing `iat`/`exp` drift vs IdP. Posting sample: ```ERROR oidc/verify.go: token exp 2024-11-03T11:12:08Z now 2024-11-03T11:11:02Z````
Marta (Customer Success): Victor from HelixBank is on the thread — Victor, are customers seeing downtime or elevated latencies?
Victor (HelixBank SRE): Yes, our users get 401s on login and API calls that require tenant tokens. Impacting ~30% of traffic to our auth-backed endpoints. Major customer blocking checkout flows.
Priya (SRE-oncall): Thanks. Paging timeline: incident declared, severity S2 -> may escalate if continues. Triage hypothesis: clock drift on private pool nodes causing OIDC assertions to be rejected by vendor IdP. Have we recently rotated certs or changed time config?
Tim (Security Engineer): No cert rotation scheduled. But we pushed a k8s node maintenance image yesterday to that pool. Could be NTP issue.
Ajay (eng-infra): Checking ntp/chrony: `chronyd` shows unsynced on 3/12 pods, drift ~+120s. This would cause tokens with strict exp window to look expired to the IdP.
Priya (SRE-oncall): Ok, immediate mitigation options: 1) Force ntp sync on affected nodes, 2) Failover traffic to standby dedicated pool in another region, 3) Exchange short-term fallback tokens with HelixBank (manual). Which do we do first?
Marta (Customer Success): HelixBank asks for the fastest fix. They prefer route 1 then 2 if not stable. They want live updates every 5m.
Priya (SRE-oncall): I'll run sync and monitor. Ajay, can you remote-exec `chronyc makestep` on the three pods?
Ajay (eng-infra): Running now: ```for node in node-a node-b node-c; do ssh $node sudo chronyc makestep; done```
deploy-bot: deploy job 8842 started by Ajay — remote commands executing.
Ajay (eng-infra): Results: node-a OK, node-b OK, node-c failed with `permission denied` (weird). Trying alternate: `sudo systemctl restart chronyd` on node-c.
Priya (SRE-oncall): Monitoring auth-proxy logs for tokens acceptance.
Priya (SRE-oncall): After makestep, error rate dropped to ~8% -> still elevated but better.
Victor (HelixBank SRE): We're seeing partial recovery — logins improved but some sessions still 401. Our telemetry shows retries succeed sometimes.
Tim (Security Engineer): Could there be clock skew between our auth-proxy and the IdP validating tokens? Need to ensure both ends are within tolerance. Also confirm token issuance TTL.
Ajay (eng-infra): Confirmed chrony restarted on node-c and drift resolved. All nodes now show NTP sync. `chronyc tracking` returns PPS offset ~0.02s.
Priya (SRE-oncall): Good. Re-checking metrics: auth 5xx down to 1.2% over last 2m. Latency normal.
Victor (HelixBank SRE): Still seeing intermittent 401s from an internal batch job that uses long-lived service tokens. Could be cached old tokens with earlier rejected exp.
Marta (Customer Success): Victor, can you rotate that service token / re-auth the job to get fresh tokens? We'll coordinate a short maintenance window if needed.
Victor (HelixBank SRE): Can do. Scheduling immediate rotation; expected 2m downtime for that job.
Priya (SRE-oncall): Action items for now: - Verify no other pools affected; - Run audit of recent node maint windows; - Add NTP healthcheck to pool readiness; - Temporary alert noise threshold lowered to catch early drift. Ajay, please open a follow-up ticket for infra change.
Ajay (eng-infra): Created INFRA-1729: "chrony unsynced after node image update" — assigning to infra. Also adding postmortem tag.
Tim (Security Engineer): We should also log this as potential token validation risk with details to compliance. Might need meeting with HelixBank security for root cause and controls.
Marta (Customer Success): I'll set up a 30-min post-incident call with Victor and his security lead. Proposed time: in 45m.
Priya (SRE-oncall): Quick config snippet I used to detect NTP drift in prod: ```# prometheus rule - ntp drift alert
- alert: NodeNtpDrift
  expr: abs(node_time_seconds - time()) > 30
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Node NTP drift > 30s"```
Ajay (eng-infra): Pushing that rule to monitoring staging now. Will roll to prod after 2h validation.
deploy-bot: deployment INFRA-1729/monitoring-rule started -> staged -> success (staging).
Priya (SRE-oncall): Customer impact: HelixBank logins degraded for ~18m peak; some batch jobs retried; no data loss. Severity remains S2 per customer business impact.
Victor (HelixBank SRE): Thank you all. Appreciate the quick response. We'll hold the rotation window and confirm success.
Priya (SRE-oncall): Closing active mitigation. Leaving incident open for postmortem and RCA. Next: longer term mitigations: - NTP healthchecks + alerts, - include chrony restart in node update runbook, - confirm token TTL tolerances with IdP, - consider token acceptance grace in auth-proxy (configurable leeway).
Tim (Security Engineer): Note: acceptance leeway blunts strict clock checks — discuss with compliance before changing.
Marta (Customer Success): I'll coordinate the postmortem invite and include the SRE/infra/security leads + HelixBank contacts.
Priya (SRE-oncall): Thanks team. I'll update the incident channel and close out when postmortem is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged, status: mitigated (partial). Incident owner: Priya (SRE-oncall). Log ref: INC-2026-3467890123.
